catalogDefinition.scope: Current food and nonalcoholic products for Barley Mac at 1600 Wilson Boulevard, Arlington, Virginia across lunch/dinner, brunch, kids, pickup, desserts, sides, and catering.
catalogDefinition.toastSnapshotAssessment: The readable search snapshot is sufficiently current and location-specific for POC catalog identity: it identifies Barley Mac at 1600 Wilson Boulevard, matches the currently linked official July 2025 lunch/dinner and brunch rows and current prices, and exposes the N/A Beverages and Catering categories hidden while live ordering is temporarily unavailable.
catalogDefinition.allergenBoundary: Menu names and descriptions support direct named positives only. No reviewed source supplies a complete allergen matrix, verified negative matrix, may-contain matrix, or cross-contact disclosure.
catalogDefinition.rationale: The homepage is current navigation support rather than an item catalog. The currently linked official Lunch & Dinner, Brunch, and Kids PDFs are authoritative service menus. The exact-location Toast snapshot is accepted as a current linked-vendor catalog presentation for pickup, nonalcoholic beverages, and catering. Catering food is in POC scope but its party-size rows are alternate quantities of dine-in or brunch product identities and are deduplicated rather than treated as separate products.
